text:
dana: Kicking off rollout for release/2026-03-22 during change window. Start at 5% for embeddings-v2 on us-east. Primary watch: p95, autoscaler, and 5xx.

deploy-bot: [automated] Rollout start: release/2026-03-22 -> nodeset-rollout-03. traffic=5%. Preflight checks OK.

rory: seeing p95 on canary jump from 180ms -> 650ms within last 3m. Also slight increase in pod restarts on nodeset-rollout-03.

alerts-bot: Alert: embeddings-v2 p95 > 500ms for 3m. severity=warn. link: https://alerts.redwood/9912

dana: hold ramp. do not advance to 20%. is autoscaler scaling up aggressively? that could cause cold starts.

rory: autoscaler did add pods twice in 6m due to a small traffic spike; HPA cool-down was 30s so we hit short thrash windows. Restart logs show warmup time ~300ms for model init.

priya: suggestion: pin runtime to stable v1.24.0 for the canary nodeset and set HPA min replicas to 3 to avoid oscillation. Also enable transient token-bucket rate limit on new pods for 60s.

dana: good plan. @deploy-bot apply pin and feature toggles, hold traffic.

deploy-bot: Applying operations:
````
pin: nodeset-rollout-03 -> runtime=v1.24.0
featureflag: enable transient_rate_limit_on_pod_start=true for nodeset-rollout-03
hpa: set min_replicas=3 for nodeset-rollout-03
````
Operations complete.

rory: after pin and rate-limit, p95 dropped to ~240ms over last 90s. pod restarts stopped.

dana: keep at 5% for 10 more minutes. if stable, ramp to 30% then pause for 15m. document the pin and HPA tweak in release notes.

alerts-bot: Alert resolved: embeddings-v2 p95 back to baseline. closing 9912.

priya: filing follow-up ticket INF-2144 to investigate worker warmup improvements and HPA cooldown tuning.

dana: thanks—closing watch after 30m if no further regressions. :thumbsup:
